CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 6
   D. 7

2. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

6. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 3
   D. 11

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 22
   C. 36
   D. 77

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 14

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

14. Solve for x: x + 5 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 14
   C. 9
   D. 5

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 32
   D. 4

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 105

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

19. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

20. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

21. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

22. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

23. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 2

24. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
